doc.name: G — 30s sports kit reveal set in a modern office, suspenseful in tone, a two-person duo, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: sports kit reveal set in a modern office, suspenseful in tone
Hero: a two-person duo
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the sports kit reveal set in a modern office, suspenseful in tone form, built around a two-person duo.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a whip pan that resolves onto the subject in Act 1 against a crane-down descending from overhead into a level medium in Act 3 — while holding the near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second sports kit reveal set in a modern office, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same two-person duo.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance, shot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/2.8, framed with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a ring light on axis for flat, modern, shadowless coverage; grade as a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second sports kit reveal set in a modern office, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same two-person duo.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a 180-degree orbit sweeping camera-right, shot on a 135mm telephoto at f/1.8, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows; grade as a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second sports kit reveal set in a modern office, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same two-person duo.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves, shot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/4, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.
